history.answer: For the past six months, my periods have become unusually heavy and I feel constant pressure in my lower belly, along with having to pee all the time.
My cycle has always come like clockwork every twenty-eight days, and that timing hasn't changed.
It has gotten so heavy that I soak through eight to ten large pads a day on the heaviest days and pass quarter-sized blood clots.
My bleeding used to last four or five days, but now it drags on for eight or nine days every single month.
No, I have not missed any periods.
No, I do not bleed between my periods, and I have never bled after intercourse.
It is not a sharp cramping pain, but more of a constant, heavy fullness pressing down in my lower pelvis.
I have to run to the bathroom every hour or two during the day, but it does not hurt or burn when I pass urine.
I have been feeling drained and exhausted lately, and I sometimes feel lightheaded when I stand up quickly from my desk.
I get a bit winded climbing the stairs at school recently, but I haven't noticed my heart racing or pounding.
No, I haven't had any acne, unusual hair growth on my face or chin, or unexplained weight gain.
No, I tolerate hot and cold temperatures fine and haven't had unexpected sweating or chills.
No, I have never had any fluid leaking from my breasts, and I don't suffer from headaches or blurry vision.
My work is busy as usual, but I haven't had overwhelming emotional stress, strict diets, or intense workouts.
No, I don't get nosebleeds, bleeding gums, or easy bruises, and I didn't bleed unusually after dental work or giving birth.
I was wondering if I might have uterine fibroids or some other kind of benign growth inside my womb.
I am worried this heavy bleeding has made me severely anemic, and I am scared I might end up needing a hysterectomy.
I was really hoping we could do a pelvic ultrasound today to see what is going on.
I have always been healthy and have never had high blood pressure, diabetes, or thyroid trouble.
I have never had surgery, and the only times I stayed in a hospital were for the births of my two children.
I have two children delivered vaginally at full term without any complications.
My husband and I are very content with our two kids and do not plan on having any more children.
I get a Pap smear every two years through routine checkups and every test has been completely normal.
I do not take any prescription medications, birth control pills, hormonal treatments, or aspirin.
I don't have any allergies to medications or anything else that I know of.
My last period started about two weeks ago and lasted eight days before stopping completely.
I am sexually active only with my husband, and we consistently use condoms for birth control.
There is almost no chance I could be pregnant, and I took a home pregnancy test last week that was negative.
My mother had very heavy menstrual bleeding from fibroids and ended up having a hysterectomy in her late forties.
I have never smoked cigarettes or used tobacco products.
I only drink an occasional glass of wine once or twice a month with dinner.
I work as a middle school teacher and live with my husband and our two children.

exam.finding: Alert, comfortable at rest, with mild facial and mucosal pallor.
Blood pressure 115/75 mmHg, heart rate 78 beats/min, respiratory rate 16 breaths/min, temperature 36.6 C, oxygen saturation 99% on room air.
Mild bilateral conjunctival pallor; sclerae are anicteric.
Thyroid is normal in size, smooth, non-tender, and mobile without palpable nodules.
Abdomen is flat and symmetrical with no surgical scars, visible masses, or distension.

Firm, smooth, non-tender suprapubic mass palpated extending midway between the symphysis pubis and the umbilicus, consistent with an enlarged uterus around 12 to 14 weeks size; no guarding or rebound tenderness.

Bimanual examination confirms an enlarged, irregularly contoured, firm, non-tender, and mobile uterus measuring approximately 12 to 14 weeks gestational size with normal non-tender adnexa; speculum exam shows a normal closed cervix with no active bleeding.
No hirsutism, acne, acanthosis nigricans, petechiae, or ecchymoses.
